t.zh: 这座城市的路口既要花体力，有的还塌成了坑，根本过不去。
t.en: In this city every crossing costs energy, and some have caved in and can’t be passed at all.

goal.zh: 只能往右或往下走，绕开所有的坑。从左上走到右下，最少要花多少体力？
goal.en: Only right or down, avoiding every pit. Going from the top left to the bottom right, what is the least energy you can spend?

body.zh: 最省力格管体力，拦截闸管坑。两个都是你前面造出来、学会的东西，这里只是把它们接在一起。
body.en: The Cheapest cell takes care of energy, the Block gate takes care of pits. Both are things you built or learned earlier; here you only wired them together.

body.zh: 坑上是「—」：取较小会跳过它，所以经过坑的路线自然被排除了。
body.en: A pit holds “—”, and “min” skips it, so routes through a pit drop out by themselves.

say.zh: 有的路口是坑，过不去。读一读「是石头」。
say.en: Some crossings are pits and can’t be passed. Read “is rock”.

hints.zh: 体力和坑，这两件事你以前分别处理过吗？
hints.en: Energy and pits: have you handled each of them before?

hints.zh: 坑上要掐断：拦截闸在条件是「是」时输出「—」。
hints.en: Cut off the pits: a Block gate outputs “—” when its condition is “yes”.
